items.component: pk_core dependency and executable suite-level release gate
items.detail: pk_core is not bundled or declared by this archive. The three framework conformance tests therefore skip; production certification cannot be reproduced from this repository alone.
items.evidence_4_3_0: tools/certify.py (dev/certification profiles, hard-fail, API+version probe, evidence); SPEC_MANIFEST.json pk_core contract; CI gate job
items.external_dependency: W-001: pk_core version/source/hash must be supplied by suite owner

items.detail: README 4.1.0 claimed this file was carried verbatim, but the archive does not contain it. 4.2.0 corrects the claim but cannot reconstruct a verbatim missing source artifact.
items.evidence_4_3_0: NFR.md SHALL requirements stand in; not reconstructed (would be fabrication)

items.detail: No owner, on-call, escalation target, or support contact is present.
items.evidence_4_3_0: OWNERS.yaml (accountable owner, escalation ladder, support hours)

items.detail: No machine-readable mapping from every checklist requirement to concrete code/test/evidence exists. The component adapter exercises selected items only.
items.evidence_4_3_0: tools/traceability.py + TRACEABILITY.json (100/100 mapped, evidence paths validated, CI --check, test_operations)

items.detail: No tests exercise INV-41, INV-13, INV-11, PLN-03, real ABI/WIT boundaries, process transfer, reconnect, or degraded control plane behavior.
items.evidence_4_3_0: adapters.py (INV-41 source, INV-13 ABI boundary), tests/test_integration.py (process transfer, degraded control plane, schema conformance), wit/inv42-descriptor.wit

items.detail: Scoped descriptors/file descriptors, sockets, WIT imports, pk_core, and related protocol/runtime versions are not pinned in a dependency/specification manifest.
items.evidence_4_3_0: SPEC_MANIFEST.json (protocols, runtime, adjacent layers, tooling)

items.detail: No pyproject/setup/lock/environment manifest defines installation, Python bounds, or the pk_core dependency. Compatibility is documented but not enforced.
items.evidence_4_3_0: pyproject.toml (Python bounds, stdlib-only runtime, extras), requirements-release.txt hash policy

items.component: CI pipeline and mandatory release checks
items.detail: No CI workflow runs unit, optimized-mode, integration, fuzz, benchmark, security, coverage, or pk_core gates on change/release.
items.evidence_4_3_0: .github/workflows/ci.yml (matrix tests, -O, extended fuzz, traceability, coverage, perf, certification, release build/verify, exit gate)

items.detail: This archive contains no LICENSE/NOTICE, so distribution terms are not self-contained.
items.evidence_4_3_0: LICENSE (all-rights-reserved holding notice), NOTICE

items.detail: Typed local exceptions exist, but end-to-end operation outcomes, retryability, cancellation, timeout, and backpressure semantics are not specified.
items.evidence_4_3_0: outcomes.py TAXONOMY/classify/RETRY_POLICY; OutcomeTaxonomyTest

items.detail: Cloud/datacenter/near-edge/far-edge applicability, disconnected behavior, and precedence among security/residency/SLO/cost constraints are not defined.
items.evidence_4_3_0: NFR.md deployment contexts, disconnected, precedence, unsupported

items.detail: Zero-error security SLOs are declared, but latency, availability, determinism, throughput, support, and tail-latency thresholds are not quantified.
items.evidence_4_3_0: NFR.md quantitative table, PERF_THRESHOLDS.json, SLO.md

items.detail: The runtime has almost no mutable configuration, but the repository does not formally mark these configuration requirements N/A or define provenance/atomic rollback if configuration is later introduced.
items.evidence_4_3_0: NFR.md Configuration: no mutable config; rules if introduced

items.component: artifact integrity, provenance, SBOM, and release signing
items.detail: No hashes/provenance attestations, SBOM, dependency verification, signed release manifest, or approved-version policy is included.
items.evidence_4_3_0: tools/release.py (reproducible archive, CycloneDX SBOM, SLSA provenance, Ed25519 signed manifest, verify incl. rebuild), RELEASE.md, KEY_MANAGEMENT.md

items.detail: PK_DESCRIPTOR/2 authenticates the descriptor itself but does not authenticate remote peers or encrypt bearer descriptors in transit. SECURITY.md explicitly delegates this to the containing transport.
items.evidence_4_3_0: transport.py TLS1.3 mTLS profile, identity pin, bounded frames; TransportTest (round-trip, rogue CA, plain socket); ADR-0003

items.detail: No integration contract defines trust bootstrap or fail-closed behavior for unavailable external identity, attestation, policy, key, or time services.
items.evidence_4_3_0: key_provider fail-closed (KeyUnavailable), NFR.md External services, KeyProviderTest, degraded-control-plane test

items.detail: In-memory counters exist, but security-sensitive operations are not emitted to a tamper-evident audit ledger with retention/privacy/export policy.
items.evidence_4_3_0: audit.py hash chain + MAC + anchored head + allow-list; AuditTest (modify/delete/reorder/truncate/re-forge)

items.detail: The per-table key is random and best-effort zeroized, but there is no OS/hardware protected-memory facility, rotation for long-lived sessions, or external key-management integration.
items.evidence_4_3_0: key_provider injection, rotation-by-table-replacement, KEY_MANAGEMENT.md
items.external_dependency: W-007: no protected memory in CPython

items.detail: No process crash, resource pressure, forced failure, dependency failure, or recovery-objective fault tests are present.
items.evidence_4_3_0: FaultInjectionTest (mint failure no partial commit - bug fixed, close failure, restart, child crash), observer-failure test

items.detail: status() exposes bounded counters, but no readiness/health endpoint, stall threshold, dependency status, or active-capability export is implemented.
items.evidence_4_3_0: telemetry.health (ready/degraded/not_ready, saturation, stall)

items.detail: Counters are only returned in-process; no OpenTelemetry/Prometheus/other exporter, rates, latency histograms, saturation model, or resource-use metrics exist.

items.detail: No structured event/log API exists. SECURITY.md says bearer descriptors must not be logged, but there is no logger adapter or redaction test.
